# Oppi Digital Products — Full LLM Context

> Oppi Digital Products is a crypto-native digital product storefront and MCP server for freelancers, creators, consultants, and AI agents. Every pack has free samples. Full packs are delivered instantly after on-chain payment verification. No accounts, no email required, no subscription.

## Storefront & Source
- Storefront: https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products
- npm MCP server: https://www.npmjs.com/package/oppi-digital-products-mcp
- Agent manifest: https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/.well-known/agent.json
- llms.txt: https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/llms.txt
- Issue #1 fulfillment: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/issues/1

## 5-Step Autonomous Purchase & Fulfillment
1. **Inspect catalog**: browse catalog/free samples or call MCP `list_products` + `get_free_sample`.
2. **Choose pack/bundle**: individual pack = 5 USDC, All-3 Bundle = 12 USDC.
3. **Send exact payment**: transfer exact amount to the verified oppi wallet address for chosen chain/asset. Never send seed phrases/private keys; agent does not sign/broadcast.
4. **Open/comment on GitHub Issue #1** with `tx_hash + chain + pack_id`: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/issues/1
5. **Receive instant automated fulfillment link** after on-chain verification.

## MCP Server
Install/run (stdio):
```bash
npx -y oppi-digital-products-mcp
```

Tools:
- `list_products` — catalog with prices and bundle.
- `get_free_sample` — free excerpt before purchase.
- `get_payment_instructions` — exact amount, chain/asset, verified wallet address.
- `verify_payment` — read-only on-chain verification (public explorers/RPC, no keys).
- `request_delivery` — returns fulfillment instruction; fulfillment is triggered by Issue #1 comment with tx_hash+chain+pack_id.

## Products

### Freelance Delivery Prompt Pack (5 USDC)
30+ tested prompts covering leads/discovery, proposals/scope, onboarding, delivery updates, feedback/QA, difficult-client situations, testimonials, retainers.
- Free sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/freelance-prompt-pack/sample-lead-qualification-scorecard.md

### Notion Freelancer CRM & Pipeline Kit (5 USDC)
Complete Notion workspace blueprint: leads/clients CRM, project tracker, invoice/revenue database, dashboard views, setup/formulas.
- Free sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/notion-crm-kit/sample-crm-database-blueprint.md

### AI Content Repurpose Pack (5 USDC)
Turn one asset into LinkedIn/X/Instagram posts, threads, newsletters/email sequences, short-form video scripts, blog/SEO outlines, 7-day calendar.
- Free sample: https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/blob/master/previews/content-repurpose-pack/sample-core-extraction.md

### All-3 Bundle (12 USDC)
Includes all three packs in one delivery.

## Safety / Constraints
- Public addresses only; no private keys/seeds in repo.
- Paid archives are never committed to public repo; delivery happens after verified on-chain payment.
- `verify_payment` is read-only/best-effort; fulfillment confirms on-chain before delivery.
